{{Top|leg}}
'''Tech scanners'''<ref name="Scanners">{{JournalCite|4|Cracken's Rebel Field Guide: Scanners}}</ref> or '''technical scanners'''<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> were handheld devices that were used by [[Technician/Legends|technicians]] to help diagnose a variety of technical and mechanical problems<ref name="Scanners" /> in [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift drives]] or other common machinery.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> The [[Techaide]], manufactured by [[Drever Corporation]], was a type of tech scanner.<ref name="Scanners" />
